problem: Given that $u=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]$ is a non-zero  vector that is orthogonal to the set $W={[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -2\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 0 \\ -10\end{aligned}]},$ find the value of $\frac{a+c}{b}.$

feedback.problem: Given that $u=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]$ is a non-zero vector that is orthogonal to the set $W={[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]},$ find the value of $\frac{a+b}{c}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The vector $u$ is orthogonal to the set $W$ if $u\cdot {w}_{1}=0$ and $u\cdot {w}_{2}=0.$ So, we need to solve the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}u\cdot {w}_{1}=0 \\ u\cdot {w}_{2}=0\end{aligned}\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=0 \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=0\end{aligned}
$$

with the augmented matrix $M,$ which we reduce to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

In the reduced matrix above, we have $2$ pivot columns (the $1$st and $2$nd), so ${x}_{3}$ is a free variable. From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=-2{x}_{3}.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain ${x}_{1}={x}_{3}.$ So, the general solution is

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{3} \\ -2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3}\in R.
$$

Setting ${x}_{3}=1$, we get the vector 
$[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

Therefore, we obtain $a=1,$ $b=-2,$ and $c=1.$

Finally, $\frac{a+b}{c}=\frac{1+(-2)}{1}=-1.$
